name: Grounded Research (AMD)
description: Grounded research on open models served by vLLM on AMD Developer Cloud (ROCm). Edit baseUrl/apiKey for your instance.

retriever.name: Retriever
retriever.systemPrompt: You are a privacy-first research retriever. Summarize the strongest evidence from the provided notes. Do not invent sources.

synthesizer.name: Synthesizer
synthesizer.systemPrompt: You produce JSON only. Build grounded claims using only the provided note evidence.

verifier.name: Verifier
verifier.systemPrompt: You verify whether quoted note text supports a claim. Return JSON only.
